notes.title: Go Kart Racing 2 - Changelog
notes.content:
New changes will improve optimization, frame rate, performance, and the career mode save system has been slightly adjusted to ensure accuracy upon loading a career save file.



Additional changes include minor changes to the way that the AI Drivers control and react to the local player.   Race settings have also been adjusted with enhanced difficulty selection in the career mode.



Some scores were failing to upload to the Steam Leaderboard at one of the tracks.  So that has been resolved and lap times will now upload properly. 



Other minor fixes were also published.
